description: Suno Studio effect. Tames harsh sibilance ('s', 'sh', 't') by isolating the high band, following its envelope, and ducking it when it exceeds a threshold. Apply to rendered vocal audio inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Tames harsh sibilance by isolating the high band, following its envelope, and ducking it when it exceeds a threshold.

frequency.description: Corner frequency of the sibilant band (highpass split).
frequency.label: Freq

threshold.description: Level above which the sibilant band is ducked.
threshold.label: Thresh

reduction.description: How much of the over-threshold sibilant band is removed.
reduction.label: Reduction

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
